FOREWORD This Indian Standard was adopted by the Bureau of Indian Standards, after the Pallets Sectional Committee had been approved by the Heavy Mechanical Council. the draft finalized by Engineering Division

In the formulation of this standard, assistance has been derived from draft Technical Report ISO/TR 10233 : 1989 `General purpose flat pallets for through transit of goods - Performance requirements', issued by the International Organization for Standardization ( IS0 ).
